::: {.callout-note title="About the 2019–2025 gap in my publication record."}
The gap corresponds to my industry years at Biogemma and then Limagrain, where research is internal and remains confidential.
See the [curriculum](curriculum.qmd) section for more information on the content of this professional experience.
These years shaped the questions I work on today: how a statistical model turns into an actual selection decision, and why methods have to run at scale.
As a consultant (2023–2026), I resumed publishing alongside client work.
:::
